## Schema

### Optional

- `list_oneof_request` (List of String) list oneOf request only maxItems (union of 1 and 2)
- `list_oneof_request_and_response` (List of String) list oneOf request and response maxItems (union of 1 and 2)
- `list_oneof_response` (List of String) list oneOf response only maxItems (union of 1 and 2)
- `list_request` (List of String) list request only maxItems (1)
- `list_request_and_response` (List of String) list request and response maxItems (both 12)
- `list_response` (List of String) list response only maxItems (2)
- `list_with_minitems` (List of String) list request and response maxItems (both 12) and minItems (both 11)
- `set_oneof_request` (Set of String) set oneOf request only maxItems (union of 1 and 2)
- `set_oneof_request_and_response` (Set of String) set oneOf request and response maxItems (union of 1 and 2)
- `set_oneof_response` (Set of String) set oneOf response only maxItems (union of 1 and 2)
- `set_request` (Set of String) set request only maxItems (1)
- `set_request_and_response` (Set of String) set request and response maxItems (both 12)
- `set_response` (Set of String) set response only maxItems (2)
- `set_with_minitems` (Set of String) set request and response maxItems (both 12) and minItems (both 11)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_maxitems.my_testing_oas_maxitems
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_maxitems.my_testing_oas_maxitems "..."
```
